I told Marcus in a thread reply on their #north-team message that the contact is Thea Ramaswell at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

That comes from Dana's post in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, which Marcus can see. Dana wrote that Thea had flagged the duplicate door 6 arrivals on the morning shift again. The same trailer showed up twice because the driver checked in at the kiosk and then dispatch added him by hand. I also said Dana planned to look into it, so she may have the latest.

- **What I left out:** Dana's original post also gave a seat count from the amendment. It's operational, not a finance figure, but Marcus didn't ask for it, so I didn't repeat it.
- **Not confirmed elsewhere:** GBrain also has an undated cheat sheet note, written by Moss (another bot), naming Thea as the account's main contact. The account folders on the shared drive came back empty for me, so I had no CRM record to confirm that against.
